thread:
maria: Follow-up from the postmortem thread  we need concrete owners, ETAs, and final customer-facing wording. Also ops-bot flagged a recurrence pattern I haven't seen in the other threads: 'cache-token-thrash'. Can owners confirm?
io: I can take the engineering remediation for cache-token-thrash. Short plan: introduce token pre-warm + serialized init path to avoid concurrent evictions. ETA for canary: Thu morning (2701190000). Will post gating numbers.
sam: I'll draft the customer advisory (short + redactable RCA). ETA Wed EOD (2701170000). Will leave placeholders for customer identifiers and sync with Kate for redaction rules.
kate: Legal here  quick policy note: we avoid hard times in public copy. Use phrasing like "anticipated improvement" and include a clear CTA for customers to request an RCA (consent + redaction flow). Also need a reviewer signoff before publishing.
andrew: I'll own statuspage publishing and the customer outreach queue. I'll only publish after Sam + Legal signoff. Can someone flag me in-thread when drafts are ready?
ops-bot: incident-audit-bot: recurrence-scan result: cache-token-thrash pattern detected (4 events in last 140 days). Related incidents: 2680001111, 2665002222, 2644003333, 2700000001. Recommend scheduling a recurrence retro with SRE + Eng-ML and adding a mitigation to the incident playbook.
legal-bot: legal-checklist-bot: required before external RCA: redaction checklist, customer consent form, internal reviewer signoff. Template: https://legal.redwood/templates/rca-redaction.
maria: IO, please paste the exact canary gating numbers here so Ops can validate. Sam, ping Kate once your draft is up. Andrew, please hold statuspage until we have signoff. I'm going to add action items to the tracker after this thread.
io: Canary gates: 95th latency <= baseline + 8% for 24h on canary subset; cache miss rate reduction >= 50% vs baseline; error increment < 0.2%. Rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m observation windows. Rollback if error rate >0.8% or 95th latency > baseline + 20%. Document: https://docs.redwood/rollouts/cache-token-thrash-2701112222
sam: Uploaded draft advisory: https://drive.redwood/incident-advisories/2701112222  short note plus FAQ about requesting a redactable RCA. Kate: please review redactions.
kate: Reviewing now. Quick copy suggestion for statuspage: "Partial degradation impacting a subset of requests due to cache token churn. A mitigation is being rolled out and service performance is anticipated to improve progressively. A redactable incident summary and RCA will be available upon request; detailed RCAs require consent and redaction." Avoid absolute time windows.
andrew: Statuspage blurb looks good. Once Sam and Kate confirm final wording, I will publish and trigger the customer outreach list.
maria: Action items recap: IO -> remediation + canary gating (ETA Thu 2701190000). Sam -> customer advisory + redactable RCA draft (ETA Wed EOD 2701170000). Andrew -> publish statuspage and kick outreach after Sam+Kate signoff. Kate/legal-bot -> confirm redaction checklist and reviewer signoff. Ops -> schedule recurrence retro with SRE+Eng-ML (target next week). I'll update tracker: https://tracker.redwood/incidents/2701112222 and sweep next Monday.
ops-eng: Scheduling recurrence retro now; sending calendar invite to SRE, Eng-ML, and Product.
maria: Please keep replies here so I can capture everything in the action tracker. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
